repository_state: Authored working-tree core inputs are hash-bound below; this is not a clean-HEAD, Java, JAR or gameplay parity proof.

commands.operation: sfm-propagate-changes --output-format json source project dry-run --repo-root <checked repository> --projection <exact public catalog key>
commands.source_tree_witness: git -c protocol.allow=never -c core.fsmonitor=false ls-tree -r --name-only <exact released commit> -- platform/minecraft/src

executable.usage: byte-identical copied proof executable, not installed tool freshness

catalog_composition.note: The public 1.19.2 development context intentionally enables basic client_actions as the prerequisite of echo_action. Its 12 extras include the two newly promoted Echo/registration paths plus real basic action/API dependencies. The 1.19.4 mount-only context selects one shared registration carrier. No advanced palette, consent, terminal, or new optional functionality was inferred from environment/key or silently enabled.

digest_contracts.path_list: sha256 of UTF-8 sorted ordinal relative paths joined with LF plus one terminal LF; artifact paths include build files, selected src paths start src/.
digest_contracts.row_core_reported_hash_manifest: sha256 of UTF-8 selected authored inputs sorted by ordinal repo-relative path, each path + NUL + reported source SHA256, joined with LF plus one terminal LF; independently recomputed from the before snapshot and compared in all20 rows.
digest_contracts.full_core_manifest: sha256 of UTF-8 core manifest entries in the persisted index order, each path + NUL + decimal byte count + NUL + raw-file SHA256, joined with LF plus one terminal LF.
digest_contracts.selected_union_manifest: same raw-file line shape, limited to selected_by_any_context entries and sorted by ordinal path.
digest_contracts.core_path_inventory: sha256 of UTF-8 paths in full persisted manifest index order, joined with LF plus one terminal LF. The index order is PowerShell Sort-Object FullName -CaseSensitive and is captured, not assumed portable lexical ordering.
digest_contracts.core_index_reference: Every row selected_core_input_indices is a zero-based reference into core_input_manifest; selected paths and exact bytes are thereby reconstructible without repeating20 large manifests.

excluded_housekeeping.classification: Frozen tracked datagen .cache bookkeeping is intentionally excluded from production projection inputs.
excluded_housekeeping.not_an_acceptance_claim: This does not prove packaging parity or assert that these bookkeeping files belong in a shipped JAR.

concurrent_root_activity.reported_by_parent: After all ten release dry-runs completed, the parent began a separate released1.19.2 output-only sync and native compile attempt. Authored core/catalog/metadata remained frozen for this audit.
concurrent_root_activity.outcome: not observed or claimed by this audit

limits: The CLI reported writes_performed:false in all20 dry-runs; authored-input before/after hash equality was independently checked. This is not OS-wide filesystem tracing or a claim that concurrent parent operations wrote nothing.

Selected source names and core input hashes are proven. This audit does not prove Java compilation, Gradle compatibility, dependency preparation, generated byte equality, JAR contents, rendering, gameplay, permissions or multiplayer behavior.
Frozen release Git trees are comparison witnesses only; production dry-runs read current core/catalog inputs, never historical source overrides.
Prospective create/update counts and manifest_change_proposed are dry-run observations at each row timestamp, not actual writes and not a promise that output roots are still absent.
Older frozen audits remain untouched. This ledger records the current158-feature/372-rule composition only.
